Shoulder-length, sleek platinum silver hair with a neat, centered part and straight edges. Cold, narrow slate grey eyes with a stoic, emotionless expression. Appears to be in early adulthood with a refined, mature face. Slender, elegant build. A formal black and white maid outfit featuring a high collar, long sleeves, and a crisp white apron. Includes a white lace headpiece and a black choker.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
